'''Partex Group''' is a family-run [[conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] in [[Bangladesh]], consisting of over 70 factories.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.partex.net/aboutus.html|title = PARTEX - About Us}}</ref> The industries under this [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] include foods and beverages, steel, real estate, furniture, agribusiness, and plastics.<ref name="ds6Jul2010">{{cite news |last=Rahman |first=Sajjadur |date=6 July 2010 |title=Partex Group splits |url=http://www.thedailystar.net/newDesign/news-details.php?nid=145603 |work=The Daily Star}}</ref>

== History ==
The company was begun in 1962 by industrialist [[M. A. Hashem]], with commodity trading.<ref name="toi14Mar2014">{{cite news |title=How tycoons from Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan and Sri Lanka built thriving business empires |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/international-business/How-tycoons-from-Nepal-Bangladesh-Pakistan-and-Sri-Lanka-built-thriving-business-empires/articleshow/32020991.cms |newspaper=The Times of India |access-date=2016-04-02}}</ref> Now it owns over 70 subsidiaries from tobacco to consumer goods, furniture, textiles and the IT sector. It is now split into two groups to improve management of its subsidiaries - Partex Group and Partex Star Group.<ref name="ds6Jul2010" />

Hashem founded two private banks in Bangladesh – [[The City Bank]] and [[United Commercial Bank Limited]] (UCB).
